授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course provides an overview of the broad fields of mechanical and aerospace engineering. Lectures are given by faculty members specializing in various areas of mechanical and aerospace engineering, including fluid mechanics, mechanical dynamics, micro- and nanoscale engineering, machine design, materials and manufacturing, energy systems, robotics and control, heat transfer, combustion, aircraft and spacecraft structures, and space engineering.
Through this omnibus-style course, students will become familiar with the major disciplines that constitute mechanical and aerospace engineering and gain a broad perspective on how these disciplines contribute to modern technology and society. The course also introduces students to current research topics and emerging technologies in each field.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: Students must achieve an average score of 60 or higher on the report assignments given throughout the course. The average is calculated over all scheduled lectures; A score of zero will be assigned to the report for any lecture the student does not attend.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Students must attend at least two-thirds of the lectures.
